title: Answer: disrupt recurrence and watch figure-ground and report

statements.text: The theory is checked by disrupting recurrent processing while sparing the feedforward sweep, through masking, anesthesia, lesions, drugs and timed magnetic stimulation, and measuring figure-ground signals, event-related potentials and report. Retro-cue memory tasks probe what is seen without access.

sources.quote: I have devoted a career to studying the neural mechanisms behind this stimulus
By selectively disrupting RP, but leaving FFS intact it is observed that visual awareness never arises.
